scope: Explicit-owner weekly PlanDraft activation in existing native development host; real production Auth/root/settings-route and iOS integration remain deferred.
authority: Ishmum authorized implementing the complete schedule-to-native flow; DST/overnight choices are recorded engineering decisions, not new PM answers.
fingerprint_boundary: Interactive UI observations used the preceding app build. Subsequent native edits were a model documentation comment and a test-runner failed-case diagnostic. Final debug app/test builds were reinstalled on both targets and actual native suites rerun. Final JavaScript client/Resume wording/status note changes passed the final full workspace check and production export. These builds are recorded separately, not conflated.

implementation.schema: Existing PlanDraft; complete explicit activation values required; incomplete storage drafts remain unchanged.
implementation.calendar: Monday=0 start day; overnight next date; half-open windows; saved IANA zone; gap first-valid/clamped collapse skipped; overlap earlier-start/later-end.
implementation.recurrence: Persisted native weekly template resolves on demand independently of preview horizon and JavaScript.
implementation.preview: Yesterday through seven future start dates, ended windows omitted; no native installation write.
implementation.apply: Native owner/permission/unlock/selection/install-revision validation plus atomic persistence and independent exact spec/revision/selection readback.
implementation.stop: Disables recurrence and clears grants/windows, retains settings and allowance/session history; Resume explicit/new revision.
implementation.migration: Native record v2 reads v1 and upgrades on accepted write; old binaries cannot read v2.
implementation.zone_change: Policy timezone migration remains explicitly rejected until a local test reset; Stop does not silently reset daily counters.
implementation.other_installation: Weekly apply refuses an unrelated finite test; stop verifies reviewed weekly installation.
implementation.desugaring: Pinned Google desugar_jdk_libs 2.1.5 in app/local module, minSdk unchanged at 24; actual runtime tested on API 36 only.

remaining: Production verified account/root/Settings-route binding and real Auth/tokens remain user-deferred.

privacy: Only owned test target configured; no app inventory, credentials, serials, screenshots, speech text, raw hierarchy/window data or private helper paths. No UIAutomation while accessibility active. TalkBack/speech preferences unchanged; original files/settings and reverse restored; captures removed.
publication: Local commit only; no push/CI/merge/deployment or remote/account/credential action.
